title: Our Lady of Still Waters
subtitle: She Who Absolves
text: She has existed in this world since before the fungal infection arrived — not a goddess in the divine-mandate sense, but a force of nature that has always been here: the cold wind in the middle of winter, the icy death at the bottom of a river, the stillness of a lake untouched for centuries. When the infection arrived and began altering the world, she manifested a more concentrated form in response. The world's antibody, taking a shape that could interact with the thinking beings caught up in the conflict. Those who glimpse her describe a tall woman with white hair, silver eyes, and skin faintly touched by cold water.
